name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
title: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd - 544530 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT up 126% YoY on ₹416m, but MTF book fell 10.5% QoQ to ₹11,019m after RBI funding curbs, missing the ₹15,000m target; broking revenue fell 6.8% for FY26.

triggers.label: MTF book missed ₹15,000m target
triggers.quote: we have guided towards achieving an MTF book size of ₹ 15,000 million by financial year '26

triggers.label: MTF book down 10.53% in Q4
triggers.quote: we saw a downfall in MTF book by 10.53% in quarter ended March '26

triggers.label: RBI curbs cut bank funding for brokers
triggers.quote: The change in policy reduced the avenues available from the banks to meet the working capital requirement of the company.

triggers.label: FY26 broking revenue down 6.8%
triggers.quote: For the full year '26, broking revenue stood at ₹ 4,755 million, representing a slight dip of 6.8% compared to the previous year.

triggers.label: MTF yields held, pressure possible
triggers.quote: In terms of yields, I think there might be a possibility, but as of now, we are trying to maintain those yields

guidance.quote: overall revenue number what we are trying and aiming to achieve is somewhere around 15 % to 20% growth year-on-year basis

in broking side, since it is a market-denominated factor, but still we will be able to grow somewhere around 15% or so in a broking revenue
targeted revenue split of 50-50 between non-broking and broking segments
we want to restrict ourselves up to max 1.5 kind of debt equity ratio
